name: Methyl-DOB
summary: Methyl-DOB, or N-methyl-DOB, also known as 4-bromo-2,5-dimethoxy-N-methylamphetamine, MDOB, or M-154, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families. It is the N-methyl derivative of the psychedelic drug DOB.

pharmacology.text: Methyl-DOB shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 79–80 nM and 98 nM, respectively). Its affinities for serotonin 5-HT2 receptors were 1.4- to 9.7-fold lower than those of DOB depending on the receptor and radioligand. Methyl-DOB substituted for (R)-DOB in rodent drug discrimination tests, but was approximately 16-fold less potent in comparison.

uses.en: It is a research compound with no medical use and little known recreational use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途，已知的娛樂性使用也很少。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，没有医疗用途，已知的娱乐性使用也很少。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related psychedelic amphetamines of the DOx family can cause anxiety, nausea, raised heart rate and blood pressure and very long experiences, and some have been linked to seizures and deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的 DOx 類迷幻安非他命可能引起焦慮、噁心、心跳與血壓上升，以及非常漫長的體驗，其中一些曾與癲癇發作和死亡有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的 DOx 类迷幻安非他命可能引起焦虑、恶心、心跳与血压上升，以及非常漫长的体验，其中一些曾与癫痫发作和死亡有关。

fact.en: Methyl-DOB is DOB with a methyl group on its nitrogen, the same change that turns amphetamine into methamphetamine. In psychedelic amphetamines this change usually weakens the effect sharply.
fact.zh: Methyl-DOB 是在 DOB 的氮原子上加一個甲基，這和把安非他命變成甲基安非他命的改變相同。在迷幻安非他命中，這個改變通常會使作用大幅減弱。
fact.zhHans: Methyl-DOB 是在 DOB 的氮原子上加一个甲基，这和把安非他命变成甲基安非他命的改变相同。在迷幻安非他命中，这个改变通常会使作用大幅减弱。
